routes.name: Spring Field Adda (Abbottabad) - Nathia Gali

sources.title: UPU Traffic Management Plan Abbottabad, Annexure II, bus terminal survey form E-004 'Spring Field Adda' (PDF p.202, survey 29-09-2014)

routes.notes: Suzuki Carry 'dabba' service by Spring Field Travel Services, 05:00-19:00, about 120 trips per 24 h (2014 survey). Terminal names only. The 2024 local-Suzuki sticker scheme also lists 'Galiyat' among Abbottabad local routes (Hazara Express News, 6 Aug 2024).

sources.title: UPU Traffic Management Plan Abbottabad, Annexure II, survey form E-004 'Spring Field Adda' (PDF p.202, survey 29-09-2014)

routes.notes: Suzuki Carry 'dabba', 07:00-18:00, about 2 trips per hour (2014). Kala Bagh = the Galiyat village on the Abbottabad-Nathia Gali road (assumed; form says 'KalaBagh').

routes.name: Abbottabad - Sherwan

sources.title: Abbottabad police issue sticker for local Suzuki and Carry dabba (Hazara Express News, 2024-08-06)

routes.notes: Named as one of Abbottabad's local Suzuki/Carry routes run from addas ('شیروان'), in the Aug 2024 traffic-police/Suzuki-union sticker scheme. The Abbottabad terminal is not named; no intermediate stops. The July 2026 RTA colour-coded sticker scheme (APP 7 Jul 2026) publishes no route list or colours.
